## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D1 (a, foundations). This is audit backlog UX-29 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: No screen changes. Shown as a type, spacing and width specimen in /__ui.
Findings and reviewers: F-21 · reviewers B-11, B-18, B-22, C-05, C-11, C-16.
Rationale: The app renders 12 font sizes against a documented scale of 7, has no maximum page width, and uses four different side-panel widths. The components of waves D1b and D1c need named values to build on, or each will invent its own again.
Proposed UX behaviour: Add to packages/tokens (and through the generator to tokens.css, theme.ts and the Tailwind theme in packages/ui/src/styles.css): the nine type tokens of blueprint section 5 (display, title, heading, subheading, body, body-large, label, caption, mono) with size, line height and weight, and tabular numerals as a utility; the spacing scale 2 to 64; widths (page maximum 1600, reading 1152 and about 72 characters, form 768, side panel 320 and 360 for the consultation chart panel); layout sizes (top bar 48 and 56, rail 72, sidebar 232, header row 44, gutters 16, 24 and 32); radius 6, 10, 12 and full; the two elevations; density (control 44 and 36, row 48 and 36); the breakpoint named wide at 1024 beside 360, 768, 1280 and 1600; and two motion tokens, ease-out cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) and a fast duration of 150 ms. Existing utilities keep working; no feature file changes.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md sections 2, 4, 5 and 12.
Components and tokens affected: packages/tokens/src/tokens.json, generate.mjs output (tokens.css, theme.ts), packages/ui/src/styles.css. Gallery specimen page.
Front end and back end split: Front end only (tokens and styles).
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the lint and ratchet ticket (D0). File ownership in wave D1a: this ticket and the tone-token ticket are the only ones that edit tokens.json and styles.css; this one merges first and the tone-token ticket rebases on it. Waves D1b and D1c do not edit either file.
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Effort and regression risk: M · Low. Additive; the risk is the native build reading a changed token shape.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Applying the type tokens to features, body weight 500 and the page maximum width (the after-pilot ticket that applies them). (2) Tone tokens (the next ticket). (3) Any palette or typeface change.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given packages/tokens, when the generator runs, then the nine type tokens, the spacing scale, the widths, the density values, the wide breakpoint and the two motion tokens are in tokens.css and theme.ts and usable as Tailwind utilities
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the 20 most-used screens, when they are captured before and after, then no pixel differs
- [ ] **AC3.** Given mobile/ and packages/ui-native, when their type check and tests run, then they pass with the extended tokens
- [ ] **AC4.** Given /__ui, when the type and spacing specimen is opened in English and Arabic, then each token is shown with its name and measured size, Arabic uses Noto Sans Arabic, and axe finds no violation
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the body-large token, when it is measured, then it is 16 px on a 24 px line, so a phone browser does not zoom on focus
- [ ] **AC6.** Given tokens.json, when packages/tokens tests run, then they fail if tokens.css or theme.ts was not regenerated

## Test notes

- Vitest in packages/tokens (existing tokens.test.ts extended).
- Playwright: gallery specimen in en and ar, axe clean.

## Notes / open questions

- Regression risk: low.
- Decision recorded in DESIGN.md first: the fast duration is 150 ms (the old spec said 160).
